title: Scam losses across Asia estimated at US$136.5b in past year; experts warn of growing AI threat
paragraphs: Scam losses across Asia estimated at US$136.5b in past year; experts warn of growing AI threat

The Global Anti-Scam Alliance warned that governments and companies cannot tackle the growing threat alone, as criminal syndicates exploit cross-border operations and increasingly advanced technology to evade detection.

BANGKOK: Scammers are increasingly using artificial intelligence to automate fraud and target victims on a massive scale, prompting calls for stronger international cooperation as estimated losses from scams across Asia reach US$136.5 billion over the past year.
